problem: Users have to log in separately; they want single sign-on with Azure AD (Entra ID).
workaround: Built a SAML proxy in the customer's tenant.

problem: Security team will not approve without SAML SSO through Okta.
workaround: Pilot runs with local accounts for 10 users.

problem: Need an audit log of every AI answer, with the sources cited, kept for seven years.
workaround: Nightly script copies prompts and answers to their archive.

problem: Analysts want to export results to Excel.
workaround: Copy and paste from the browser.

problem: Single sign-on with Entra ID is required before rolling out to branches.
workaround: Branch users share a service account (not acceptable long term).

problem: Compliance asks for an audit trail of model answers and who saw them.
workaround: Exporting chat transcripts weekly by hand.

problem: Need CSV export of the review queue for the weekly ops meeting.
workaround: FDE runs a SQL query each Friday.

problem: Regulator expects a log of AI decisions with the documents used.
Claims handlers want answers in Welsh.
workaround: Prompt asks the model to reply in Welsh; quality unverified.
